title: "send-customer-response skill"

---

The egress step of the IT ticketing workflow: deliver the latest drafted response and record the send.

## Layout

```text
skills/send-customer-response/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── send_customer_response.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/send-customer-response/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Send the response we drafted for TKT-00042."

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, verifies a draft exists, runs the script, and reports the delivery.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/send-customer-response/scripts/send_customer_response.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/sent_messages.csv` and writes an action-log entry.

## Public functions

- `load_send_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket and the latest customer-response draft. Raises `LookupError` if no draft exists.
- `build_send_record(context, *, channel, workflow_run_id, step_id)` — builds the row written to `sent_messages.csv`. Pure dict → dict.
- `write_sent_message(out_dir, record)` — appends the row.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing ticket / data, 3 on missing upstream draft.

## Schema of `data/working/sent_messages.csv`

| Column | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `delivery_id` | Generated `DEL-<ticket>-<timestamp>`. |
| `ticket_id` | FK to `submitted_tickets.ticket_id`. |
| `message_id` | The drafted message that was sent. |
| `draft_skill_name` | Which drafting skill produced the source draft. |
| `message_source` | `faq` or `specialist_solution`. |
| `channel` | `email`, `portal`, or `phone`. |
| `recipient_email` | From the original ticket's `submitted_by_email`. |
| `sent_at` | UTC ISO timestamp. |
| `delivery_status` | `delivered` for the prototype. |
| `skill_name` / `workflow_run_id` / `step_id` | Standard orchestration metadata. |

## Refusal behavior

The skill refuses to send when:

- the ticket id does not exist (`exit 2`), or
- there is no `customer_response_drafts.csv` row for the ticket (`exit 3`, with stderr naming the upstream skill to run instead).

## Idempotency

A retry with the same `(workflow_run_id, step_id)` returns `status=skipped` with the existing row in the JSON envelope and does not write a duplicate. To force another send event, pass a fresh `--step-id`. `--idempotency-mode replace` rewrites the existing prototype row for that step instead of appending a duplicate.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_send_customer_response.py -v
```
